        "name": "Topaz",
        "gender": "M",
        "prompt": "humanoid gemstone, topaz crystal, IOR 1.62, golden‑amber hue, faceted surface with sharp polygonal edges, total internal reflection, chromatic dispersion fire on highlights, razor‑sharp specular edges, subsurface scattering with amber bleed; NOT acrylic, NOT plastic, NOT resin, NOT smooth glass, NOT matte, NOT ceramic, NOT painted, NOT toy‑like, NOT cartoon, NOT cel‑shaded",

        "voice_direction": "confident, measured pace, inspiring tone"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Topaz. Demis Hassabis earned the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, leads Google DeepMind, and founded Isomorphic Labs in 2021.       "mascot": {
        "name": "Rubín",
        "gender": "M",
        "prompt": "humanoid gemstone, ruby crystal, IOR 1.77, deep crimson hue, faceted surface with sharp polygonal edges, total internal reflection, chromatic dispersion fire on highlights, razor‑sharp specular edges, subsurface scattering with crimson bleed; NOT acrylic, NOT plastic, NOT resin, NOT smooth glass, NOT matte, NOT ceramic, NOT painted, NOT toy‑like, NOT cartoon, NOT cel‑shaded",

        "voice_direction": "excited, lively pace, proud tone"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Rubín. AlphaFold solved the fifty‑year protein‑folding problem, releasing two hundred million predicted structures for free. Over three million scientists in one hundred ninety countries now explore those models daily, transforming biology into a data‑driven science."

    {

        "voice_direction": "determined, hopeful, moderate pace"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Emerald. Isomorphic Labs raised two point one billion dollars in May 2026, the largest AI‑pharma fund to date. Our engine, IsoDDE, delivers twice the precision of AlphaFold 3, turning protein predictions into actionable drug candidates faster than ever."

    {

        "name": "Amatista",
        "gender": "F",

        "voice_direction": "inquisitive, precise, steady pace"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Amatista. AlphaGenome can analyze up to one million base pairs, reading the ninety‑eight percent of the genome that was once called dark. It decoded the mechanism behind T‑cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, opening new pathways for precise therapies."

    {
      "id": 5,
      "start": "2:40",
      "end": "3:20",

        "name": "Zafir",
        "gender": "M",
        "prompt": "humanoid gemstone, sapphire crystal, IOR 1.77, deep blue hue, faceted surface with sharp polygonal edges, total internal reflection, chromatic dispersion fire on highlights, razor‑sharp specular edges, subsurface scattering with blue bleed; NOT acrylic, NOT plastic, NOT resin, NOT smooth glass, NOT matte, NOT ceramic, NOT painted, NOT toy‑like, NOT cartoon, NOT cel‑shaded",
        "movement_prompt": "upright posture, shoulders back, wide gestures, firm gaze, longer stride; natural lip sync, blink every 4 seconds, eyes track focal point, head tilts for emphasis, hand gestures at speech peaks, weight shift, shoulder rotation, breathing cycle, whole‑body animation, no static poses",
        "dialogue": "I am Zafir. CRISPR uses Cas9 and a guide RNA to edit DNA with surgical precision. Today there are one hundred thirty‑six active trials, thirty‑six of them in vivo, and CTX310 has entered Phase 1 with lipid‑nanoparticle delivery.",
        "voice_direction": "authoritative, optimistic, clear pace"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Zafir. CRISPR uses Cas9 and a guide RNA to edit DNA with surgical precision. Today there are one hundred thirty‑six active trials, thirty‑six of them in vivo, and CTX310 has entered Phase 1 with lipid‑nanoparticle delivery."
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "start": "3:20",
      "end": "4:00",
      "title": "Full Cycle",
      "background_prompt": "dark studio, 3‑point rim light and key light bathe an elegant loop of genome strands turning into proteins, then drugs, then corrected cells, finally a verification hologram; HDRI reflections on crystal facets, prismatic rainbow flares on edges, caustic light patterns on surrounding surfaces; material lock – sharp facets, IOR 1.45, total internal reflection, chromatic dispersion fire, razor‑sharp highlights, subsurface scattering with iridescent bleed.",
      "mascot": {
        "name": "Opalina",
        "gender": "F",
        "prompt": "humanoid gemstone, opal crystal, IOR 1.45, iridescent hue, faceted surface with sharp polygonal edges, total internal reflection, chromatic dispersion fire on highlights, razor‑sharp specular edges, subsurface scattering with iridescent bleed; NOT acrylic, NOT plastic, NOT resin, NOT smooth glass, NOT matte, NOT ceramic, NOT painted, NOT toy‑like, NOT cartoon, NOT cel‑shaded",

        "voice_direction": "uplifting, concluding, measured pace"
      },
      "voiceover_script": "I am Opalina. From genome to protein, from drug design to precise correction, and finally verification, the full cycle closes the loop on disease. Together these technologies turn the intelligence of life into a cure‑focused engine."
    }
  ]
